title: cerasus avium var. sylvestris
intro: Cerasus avium var. sylvestris, commonly known as the wild cherry or bird cherry, is a deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. It is a variant of the sweet cherry (Cerasus avium) and is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional herbal medicine. The health benefits of Cerasus avium var. sylvestris include its potential to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of colds and fever. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
